blogs.title: When the Chest Lies: Navigating the 'Pulmonary Mask'
blogs.description: This post explores the cognitive pitfalls clinicians face when a primary abdominal pathology presents as a thoracic emergency. Using this case as a template, we discuss the 'pulmonary mask'—where the focus on respiratory distress and pleural fluid leads to unnecessary empiric treatments (like antitubercular drugs) while the true source of the pathology remains hidden in the retroperitoneum.

blogs.title: Decoding the Amylase Clue: Differential Diagnosis of Hemorrhagic Effusions
blogs.description: A deep dive into the biochemical analysis of pleural fluid. We analyze the diagnostic significance of high amylase and lipase levels ($>1000$ U/L) and how to differentiate a pancreatopleural fistula (PPF) from other high-amylase conditions such as Boerhaave’s syndrome, malignancy, and tuberculosis.

blogs.title: Pediatric Pancreatitis: Trauma vs. The Genetic Blueprint
blogs.description: While alcoholic pancreatitis is the hallmark of the adult population, pediatric pancreatitis has a distinct etiology. This post discusses the role of blunt abdominal trauma versus genetic mutations (such as SPINK1 and PRSS1) in childhood pancreatic disease, and why a detailed family history is vital when managing pediatric pancreatitis.

blogs.title: Managing the Fistula: The Escalation Ladder from Conservative to Surgical
blogs.description: Because pancreatopleural fistulas are rare, standardized guidelines are sparse. This post evaluates the management hierarchy: starting with conservative measures (NPO, Octreotide, and TPN), the role of thoracic drainage, and the specific criteria for escalating to endoscopic (ERCP) or surgical intervention when medical management fails.
